title: Slack - Business messaging platform with deep Salesforce ecosystem integration
clean_text: Slack combines instant messaging, file sharing, and third-party integrations into a single business communication platform. Over 593,915 companies have adopted Slack, with 77% of Fortune 100 companies using the platform and nearly 80% of Fortune 100 companies using Slack Connect specifically for cross-company collaboration. The largest customer segments by size are companies with 20-49 employees, 100-249 employees, and 0-9 employees. Non-tech enterprises in healthcare, retail, and education are among the fastest-growing adopter segments, and sales/customer-success usage has grown following deeper Salesforce integration and no-code AI workflow tools.

meta.target: SMB through large enterprise, 77% of Fortune 100
